name: Kurihara Mariko
source:
Married for 4 years.

Former domestic flight attendant.

She and her husband, a current pilot, worked for different companies, but somehow they met and got married. Her maiden name is Domae.

She is an excellent cook and a good housekeeper. Loves new things. Loves cats. Currently enjoys playing, talking, and teasing her recently made younger friend (Chika).

[from [url=http://autobahn69.jp/Autobahn/buai.html] official site]
